features.notes: Verifies the selected Stage 4 88 model: 52 white and 36 black keys, A-to-C range, hammer action, and black-key pattern.
Verifies six ordered sections and normalized ratios.
Verifies representative section controls, stable IDs, and the two-display rule.
Pointer and computer-keyboard key depression/release.
Button toggles update state and program display.
Knob adjustment is clamped and reflected in its ARIA value.
Hardware controls have names, roles, and keyboard access.
Continuous instrument structure and no marketing hero region.
Shared note ownership, repeated notes, release, and all-notes-off paths.
Sustain and half-pedal state transitions are routed to the Piano engine.
Voice limits and deterministic ownership are covered by the audio boundary.
Touch curves and velocity response reach the audio engine.
Computer-key mapping suppresses repeats and clears on focus loss.
MIDI note, sustain, pedal, unavailable, and denied paths are injectable.
Master volume and reverb are connected to the shared audible graph.
Sample failure exposes a playable, labeled live-synthesis fallback.
Inherited Phase 1 visual and interaction coverage remains present and green.
Program save/load restores layers, Piano, effects, routing, splits, scenes, and morphs.
Store, Store As, naming, categories, Program buttons, banks/pages, and eight Live slots.
Dirty state, cancel, undo, and previous-state restoration.
Program display modes, numeric/alphabetic/category lists, preset browsing, and contextual editing.
Layer enable, focus, level, source bus, effect assignment, and master routing.
Editable Low/Mid/High points, documented positions, zone membership, note routing, and crossfade gains.
Wheel, Aftertouch, Control Pedal assignment, interpolation, indicators, limits, copying, and removal.
Layer Scene I/II changes enable states without duplicating sound parameters.
One AudioContext, per-layer chains, ordered shared master path, limiter, and cleanup.
Focus, group/global, bypass, dry/wet, ordering, targeting, and To Rotary.
Representative Mod 1, Mod 2, Delay, Amp/EQ, Compressor, Reverb, and Rotary processing changes audio frames.
All inherited Piano, visual, MIDI, interaction, and fallback coverage remains present.
